Here is a **short, firm, legally minded email** that says what you want without weakening your position or sounding unhinged. It keeps the power on your side and avoids anything that could be used against you.

:::writing{id="84219" variant="email" subject="Final Request to Execute the MDA"}
I am asking you one final time to stop the harassment and false accusations.

Your continued behavior follows a clear pattern of abuse, manipulation, and refusal to take accountability. It is common for individuals with narcissistic tendencies to deflect responsibility by rewriting reality and attempting to place blame on the person who finally chose to leave. That is exactly what you are doing.

Your claims of infidelity are false and only further demonstrate your inability to accept the truth. I did not leave because of another person. I left because of your behavior and the emotional, psychological, and physical abuse I endured. The facts do not support your narrative, no matter how many times you repeat it.

At this point, your accusations serve no purpose other than self preservation and continued control. I am not engaging in that anymore.

Please sign the MDA and allow this process to conclude so we can both move on. If the harassment continues, I will address it through legal channels.

This is your opportunity to end this respectfully.

Bethany

Write a short email response to my soon to be ex husband about how is a abusive delusional and manipulative narcissist who is harassing me at this point. Talk about how only the top narcissists don't take accountable for their evil hurtful actions and try find anything. They can to turn it around on their victims to make it seem like I'm the one who is at a fault for this marriage being ruined. His false claims of cheating is just proof that he will never change: never seeing the facts that his abuse was what made me leave not another man, but nice try. Now sign the MDA and let me go so I don't have to deal with you are your made up self preserving accusations and insults.
